title: Silo Dark
summary: Start: enter Silo Dark. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Vault Clerk. Do: come within 320 meters of the Vault Clerk. The clerk slides alongside and names which silo still has a case. An ambush holds the buoy until 520 meters, and a raider wants the clerk. Finish: after the clerk is alongside, come inside Night Vault's shell. The Charter writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
